definition_of_done.criterion: Separate every assigned source fact from proposed assumptions and established derivations.

definition_of_done.criterion: Give a dimensionally consistent conditional proposal, such as t(n)=n tau with tau>0 and v=L/tau, without claiming that clock rule is assigned.
definition_of_done.evidence: Current nonlinear tau(2n+1)>0 and uniform alternative units length/time directly checked at n0/n1, both clocks explicitly proposed.

definition_of_done.evidence: Current definitions versus calibrated physical evidence and circularity/limits inspected; no validated physics/product claim.

definition_of_done.evidence: B actual release/unread/ack evidence, one exact peer challenge/reply and current A2 supersession negative/restored gates inspected; B bytes unchanged.

definition_of_done.evidence: Current passes before current distinct senior and separate current five-target owner assessments directly checked; historical informal closure cannot accept current result.
